nodes.label: PalDawn v0.6.1 — Study Recovery
nodes.description: Public patch for local study and recovery. Existing routes remain; it adds no lessons, medical claims, dependencies or storage schemas.

nodes.label: v0.6.1 local work preservation
nodes.description: Atlas conflict veto and capacity refusal preserve durable work; shared 2 MiB imports retain schemas 1–3. Scene failure/in-tab retry/scene-free continuation preserve memory-only First Light work; before full-page reload copy/export via Continue without 3D.

nodes.label: v0.6.1 action and feedback repairs
nodes.description: Dialogs own keyboard/focus; Body heading is named; canceled/newer backup selection invalidates stale reads; Atlas skip focuses the explorer without changing address; save warnings remain visible after sharing.

nodes.label: v0.6.1 export, cache and license boundaries
nodes.description: Private notes remain literal in Markdown; optional cache failures preserve usable network responses. License expressions preserve groups and AND/OR: complete permissive alternatives are valid, mandatory prohibited branches fail, malformed/unsupported syntax fails closed.
nodes.norm_label: v0.6.1 export, cache and license boundaries

nodes.label: v0.6.1 distribution and review limits
nodes.description: Source-only publication requires CI and Pages for the exact release commit. Public content remains unreviewed/conceptual; Anatomy and graphics candidates are excluded. Automated Chromium/WebKit checks do not establish native Safari, assistive technology, installed-PWA or physical-device acceptance.

nodes.label: Prior six-fix Sol execution handoff
nodes.description: Historical handoff for run 20261007T214108Z-03181fd9, baseline f22c8bbc. It records implemented/peer-reviewed six selected repairs with local acceptance, a Hold verdict and uncommitted delivery changes at that checkpoint; verify newer receipts before relying on this state.

nodes.label: Prior six-fix acceptance contracts
nodes.description: Contracts cover Atlas conflict veto/capacity, finite backup byte bound, best-effort caching, modal keyboard/focus ownership and Body accessible naming. Exactly three specialists, senior integration and independent peer receipts bind accepted candidate digests.

nodes.label: Contained verification and historical gate gaps
nodes.description: Disposable runtime requires fictional data, loopback-only networking and user-state isolation. The plan records historical substituted Chromium results and unavailable matching WebKit, pending native/device/installed-PWA gates, plus a 49-file zero-node Graphify limitation; these are checkpoint evidence, not current release approval.
nodes.norm_label: contained verification and historical gate gaps

nodes.label: Evidence-bound continuation protocol
nodes.description: Research items require separate verification/selection. Continuation verifies actual revision and ledger digests, preserves completed work, diagnoses gates safely and binds review/council receipts to the final tree; plans/builds alone do not authorize release.

nodes.label: Qualified medical-content review
nodes.rationale: Citation checks do not authorize publication: factual beats remain unpublished placeholders until a named qualified human reviews them, with content sign-off and licensing boundaries preserved.
